title: Rolling 7-Day Revenue Sum
description:
Calculate the rolling 7-day total revenue for each day (current day plus the 6 preceding days).

**Table: daily_revenue** — `revenue_date`, `amount`

Output columns: `revenue_date`, `amount`, `rolling_7d_sum`. Order by `revenue_date`.
solution_sql: SELECT revenue_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7d_sum FROM daily_revenue ORDER BY revenue_date

test_cases.description: 14 days; first 6 rows have partial windows (fewer than 7 days); from day 7 onward the window is exactly 7 days

hints: ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW creates a sliding window that includes the current row and up to 6 rows before it.
Days 1-6 will have rolling sums over fewer than 7 days; the first full 7-day window appears at day 7.
explanation: ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW slides a window of up to 7 rows. Day 1: sum of just day 1 = 1100. Day 7: sum of days 1-7 = 7750. Day 8: sum of days 2-8 (days 1-7 drops off) = 8150. This 7-day rolling sum is a standard technique for smoothing weekly seasonality in time-series data.
